methods.label: Find the season's required wins
methods.explanation:
The \(70\%\) applies to the entire season, which has \(50+40=90\) games. The required number of wins is therefore
\[
0.70\times90=63.
\]
The team already has \(40\) wins, so it must win \(63-40=23\) of the remaining \(40\) games. Thus the answer is \(23\), choice B.
methods.levelReason: Only a percentage of a whole-number total and subtraction of an existing part are needed.
